notes.title: DeoVR app v15.1 release
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone, we bring you new release of DeoVR app - v15.1
[/p][p][b]New[/b][/p][p]- Introduced [b]"Top Picks”[/b] sorting, showcasing the greatest videos of all time[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvement[/b][/p][p]- Improved default settings for vertical flat videos[/p][p]- Added default yaw settings to ensure correct display of certain videos/photos[/p][p]- Sandbox moved to right grid panel[/p][p]- Top sorting is now Trending[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][p]- Resolved a crash affecting Pico 4 after several minutes of use[/p]

notes.title: DeoVR app release v15.0
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! New version has been released and we have fixed some bugs in this one. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][p]- Fixed color profile not being saved when re-loading the app[/p][p]- Fixed AI PT mask mismatching with higher FPS[/p][p]- Fix for “Reset to default” button not resetting correctly[/p][p]- Fixed issue with going back via "B" or "Home" button[/p]

notes.title: DeoVR version 14.8 release
notes.notes:
New version - 14.8 is now available.

[b]New[/b]
- Remote launch video on headset from web

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Cache grid content if filters were not changed - can be reset by clicking on the logo
- Improved subtitle display to prevent lines from appearing too long.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Resolved an issue where subtitles appeared on videos without subtitles.

notes.title: DeoVR v.14.7 release
notes.notes:
New version - 14.7 - is available to download. 

[b]New[/b]

- Added extreme content warning popup
- “New” is now default for creators channel
- Notification about new app version available
- Added new default transform settings for flat videos

[b]Improvements[/b]

- Updated Autofocus feature
- Updated logic for saving user input
- Options, video and 6DOF settings are now available for photos.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

- Fixed text input causing "jumping" in the comments window with a scrollbar
- Fixed delay on interactions with playlists
- Fixed issue of videos not opening after DeoVR resumed from inactivity
- Fixed high saturation adjustment causes extreme color artifacting
- Fixed sound issues related to Meta Quest v74
- Fixed “unsupported format” error on partner websites

notes.title: DeoVR app version 14.5 (Comment, Forgot password, AB loop fix)
notes.notes:
New version of DeoVR app 14.5 is available on Quest, Pico and Steam.

[b]New[/b]
- Added comments section to video player left panel
- Added “Forgot password” option to sign in window

[b]Improvement[/b]
- Search input is saved between searches

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Fixed showing video in playlist even though it was removed
- Fixed “Reset to default” binding not applying previous settings
- Fixed video restarting to beginning while seeking
- Fixed subtitles being shown behind video
- Fixed tags layout on videos with a lot of tags
- AB loop not being set properly fixed
.- Fix for previous/next button inconsistencies in player

Curved screen for flat videos

notes.title: DeoVR app release 14.1
notes.notes:
Hi guys, this is a small release this time:

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Maximum available resolution is now set as the default option until manually changed

- Corrected issue where the pointer could appear outside panel boundaries.

notes.title: Update ver. 13.6
notes.notes:
[h1]Release notes[/h1]
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added sorting panel - now you can sort by Trending, New and Top
[*] Subtitles (SRT) are now supported for local files
[list]
[*] Need to be in SRT format and should be named the same as the video (ex.: if video is named video.mp4, then subtitles should be named video.srt)
[*] They are enabled automatically if player finds subtitles locally - you can disable them via button on Player panel or inside Subtitles tab under player settings
[*] They can be moved in space by clicking on them and dragging
[*] Additional options like Font size, Depth and Background opacity can set inside Subtitles tab
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player timeline now properly aligns blue sections with seeker
[/list]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Subscribe button now gives instant feedback
[*] Split Options tab inside player settings into Player and Video options
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed Christmas 2022 virtual environment
[/list]

notes.title: Update ver. 13.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Release notes[/h1]
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Support for Meta Quest Pro
[*] Haptic feedback on controllers when hovering over buttons, sliders and scrollbars (except for Pico and HTC Vive)
[list]
[*] You can disable haptic feedback inside Global Settings under Player and switch Controllers vibration switch to off
[/list]
[*] New virtual environment for Christmas
[list]
[*] It will automatically switch to it if you have default (black) background, otherwise you can find it inside Global Settings under Personalize and select Christmas 2022
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] H265 is now the default codec on PICO devices
[*] Build-Your-Own-Journey (BYOJ) now ignores empty jumps
[*] Quality and encoding dropdown is now hidden when playing videos that do not support it
[*] Virtual environments are no longer affected by software re-center
[*] Chroma key/passthrough:
[list]
[*] Color range slider is now less sensitive
[*] Color box is now visible when dragging sliders
[*] Improved performance when using color wheel
[*] Added an icon to thumbnails on hub to easily see which videos have passthrough configured
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update ver. 13.4

[list]

[*] Changed Color Range option maximum value from 100 to 1000

[*] Note: chroma key algorithm was changed, so any previous configuration might look different now
[/list]
[*] Playlists:
[list]

[*] Added possibility to Loop Favorites, Watch Later and your custom playlists
[*] Suggested playlist list is now active by default

[/list]
